pages.title: Spacetime Anchor Core
pages.text: Negative mass pinned inside spacetime alloy. It holds the metric still while everything around it bends, a fixed point in curved space. It is heavy and light at once, and sits perfectly still no matter how hard I push it.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Graviton Condenser I set a Negative Mass Ingot inside Spacetime Alloy with Exotic Matter. The positive and negative curvatures cancelled, and the space inside stopped moving.
Made in $(item)Graviton Condenser$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Quantum Gravity.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Spacetime Anchor Pylon.
